a novel approach is proposed to improve distance protection in the SFCL environment.
the proposed approach is immune of SFCL topology, and is able to keep the sensitivity even if SFCL does not pick up.
the proposed approach is capable of improving the performance of distance relay in presence of SFCL without any modification of relay settings.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mitigation of adverse impacts of the SFCL on the performance of distance relays.
improving the performance of distance relay in the presence of the SFCL.
the mitigation of the adverse impact of SFCL on distance protection.

the proposed method is a simple and reliable approach that can be applied to different SFCL topologies.
the proposed approach has been successfully verified for different types of SFCLs.
the proposed method can improve the performance of the distance relay under the SFCL presence and it can be applied to any types of SFCL.

the proposed approach is able to improve the performance and reliability of the distance relay in the presence of the SFCL.
the proposed method has a great potential to be applied in real systems.
the proposed method is able to mitigate the adverse impacts of the SFCL on the transmission line protection and hence, the reliability of the power system is improved.

the proposed approach can be applied to different types of SFCLs.
